metadata.name: Isaac Run History
metadata.description:
[h1]Isaac Run History[/h1]
Records every run you play - wins, deaths and restarts - with the items you picked up floor by floor, bosses, the cause of death, final stats and the seed. Drop the history file on [url=https://tomandes.eu/isaac-run-history/]tomandes.eu/isaac-run-history[/url] and get statistics: win rate per character, the items that win you runs, what keeps killing you, bosses, completion marks and more.
[h2]How to use[/h2] Open the console and click [b]Run History[/b] in the menu bar, or use: [list] [*][b]runhistory[/b] (or [b]rh[/b]) - list your last 10 runs [*][b]rh export[/b] - copy the whole history (JSON) to the clipboard [*][b]rh path[/b] - where the history file is [*][b]rh web[/b] - the statistics page's link [*][b]rh notif 0[/b] / [b]rh notif 1[/b] - turn the popups at the start of a run off / on [/list]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][b]Repentance+[/b] required [*][url=https://repentogon.com]REPENTOGON[/url] required [*]Works together with ShareSeed (its share code is stored with each run) [/list]
